title: shadcn/ui
description: Beautifully designed, accessible components that you copy and paste into your apps. Accessible, customizable, and open source with full code ownership.
features: Not a component library: code lives directly in your repository
Built on accessible Radix UI primitives and Tailwind CSS utility classes
Interactive CLI (`npx shadcn@latest add button dialog`) for zero-friction adoption
Themes, CSS variables, and light/dark mode out of the box
Compatible with Next.js, Vite, Remix, Astro, and React Native
pros: 100% code ownership: modify any styling or behavior without monkey-patching
De facto standard for modern React applications
Extensive registry system for community blocks and templates
cons: Upgrading components requires manual git diffing rather than `npm update`
Initial theme configuration requires understanding Tailwind v4 CSS vars
targetAudience: Full-stack React/Next.js engineers wanting complete aesthetic control without heavy node_modules UI bloat.
